node.title: A=1 core-one two-sided complement weld
node.statement: For the official A=1 core-one maximal-degree dominant component, interpolate both the domain-saturated complement QV+P_XW=P and the slope-clean complement QA+P_clB=G_X. Eliminating their shared clean-slope product gives WB-B_XE_Z=QK and VB+AE_Z=-P_XK, where deg_X K<=D_0-1 and deg_parameter K<=T-1. The separated opposing factor B_X(X)E_Z(U,V) has bidegree at most (e-5b-1+D_*,1). This is an exact two-sided matrix-factorization normal form for the remaining mixed component, not a stratum exclusion.
